A special masking token (<MASK>) is introduced into the vocabulary to represent ”noisy” or corrupted tokens during diffusion-style generation.
To initialize the diffusion process, all target tokens were replaced with a designated mask symbol ([gMASK] for LLaDA and ¡|mask|¿) yielding a fully masked response sequence appended to the prompt.
A forward pass generated logits for all masked positions. For each position, the probability assigned to its correct token was extracted.
The position with the highest confidence was then revealed and added to the growing set of fixed tokens.
